body:
Antoniossss, please include the CakePHP version number you are using in your description. It helps us debug your issue.

--
_Automated response by [Var.CI](https://var.ci)_ :robot:
You've asked the translation value to be `''` so that's what you should get. If you don't want `''` don't make it the translated value.

But this is the case where translation is missing due to overlook not intentional action. Behavior is inconsistent - for example __("Search") will give me the default value if I ommit the context. I would expect `__()` and `__x()` work in the same fashion in case of missing translation as well as other translation functions.

It is up to you what to do about it anyway. Thanks

Pot files are never read when translating messages did you mean the po files instead? I might not be fully understanding the issue you are having. Do you have snippets of the po files and translation calls that aren't doing what you expect?

I meant `po` files, yes.

And for example, lets have following snippet from `po` file (These are actuall snippets used in my app):
```
#: Template/Pages/home.ctp:29
msgid "home.story.short"
msgstr ""

#: Template/Layout/default.ctp:92;122
#: Template/Pages/home.ctp:14
msgctxt "Navigation menu"
msgid "Search"
msgstr ""
```

and lets have
```

<?= __("home.story.short") ?> // output: home.story.short
<?= __x("Navigation menu", "Search") ?> // output: empty string

```
Whats the difference here? Both translations are described as "empty string" like you have pointed out, but outcome is different.
Ok. That behaviour should be more consistent.

issue.title: Empty message strings should return the key

repository.name: cakephp
repository.description: CakePHP: The Rapid Development Framework for PHP - Official Repository

issue.body:
context based messages should return the key when the translated value is ''. This mirrors the behavior of context-less messages. Returning '' was incorrectly added in #8932

Refs #10440
